summary: Both backend + frontend testing for multi-subject DNA + Venice.AI. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases pass (multi-subject persist w/ create+GET+PATCH+GET, backward-compat dna-only, Venice.AI freeform integration returns HTTP 200 with valid dna JSON — key is NOT capped anymore, so wiring proven end-to-end). Frontend: 13 of 14 review scenarios pass via Playwright. One minor UI bug: 'Copy A → here' button is visible even when Subject A is active; per spec it should be hidden.

ui_bugs.issue: btn-copy-from-primary is rendered whenever subjects.length>1, regardless of activeId. Per spec it should be hidden when Subject A (primary) is active — otherwise clicking 'Copy A → here' when A is active is a no-op or overwrites A with itself.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Change `{subjects.length > 1 && (...)}` to `{subjects.length > 1 && activeId !== subjects[0].id && (...)}` (component already receives activeId + subjects).

verified_behaviors.T10_switcher_hides_when_scenario_solo_an: not-verified-cleanly-in-test (stale cast_type kept expectedCount>1; per code logic the hide condition works when both cast_size=solo AND cast_type=none — user-triggered edge case, not a bug)
verified_behaviors.T11_B_auto_age_when_switching_to_mother_: 42 (B already existed so auto-seeder did NOT re-seed — expected per implementation; the 21yo seed only fires when auto-adding a new subject)

action_items: Fix SubjectSwitcher: hide btn-copy-from-primary when Subject A (primary/index 0) is the active subject (spec says the button is only for copying INTO a non-A subject).

Optional UX polish: when user picks cast_type='mother_and_daughter' after multi-subject already exists, consider re-seeding existing Subject B's age to 21 (currently seedSubjectFromPairing only runs on auto-add, so an already-added B keeps its previous age). If this is intentional, add a Copy/Randomize workflow hint in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: SubjectSwitcher.jsx line 92: `{subjects.length > 1 && (...)}` does not check activeId==primary — leads to the T7 bug above. Add `activeId !== subjects[0].id` guard.

Builder auto-add effect keyed on `${cast_size}|${cast_type}` fires only when expected>subjects.length — good. But there's no complementary auto-prune when expected drops back to 1 while extras exist. That is intentional (user data preservation) but consider a toast hint 'You now have more subjects than the scenario needs.'
PromptPreview 'Copy' still copies positive only, not negative (carry-over from iteration_7 review).

In dna.js buildMultiVenicePrompts, subject clause is `Subject A (44yo): 44-year-old, woman` — the age is duplicated (in parens AND in the clause body). Minor redundancy but does not affect correctness.
seed_data_creation: Test characters TEST_MultiSubject and TEST_SoloBC created and deleted by pytest tests (self-cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-subject persistence + Venice.AI integration verified end-to-end. Only outstanding item is the copy-button visibility bug in SubjectSwitcher — a one-line fix. Venice.AI key is currently WORKING (returns 200), not 402-capped as the review request warned; the backend correctly points to https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions and uses VENICE_API_KEY. Testids to remember: cast options use `chip-scenario-cast_size-{opt}` and `chip-scenario-cast_type-{opt}` (NOT input-* like the review request wording suggested). Section rail testids: `nav-section-{key}` (desktop, requires expanding the parent `phase-header-{phase}` first). Prompt content is inside <pre> tags under `[data-testid="prompt-string-preview"]`, not textarea.
rca of the issue: Copy-A-here button: SubjectSwitcher.jsx renders the button under `{subjects.length > 1 && ...}` without an activeId guard. Reproduction: create new char → set cast_size=duo → click subject-tab-A → button `btn-copy-from-primary` is still visible. Mitigation: add `activeId !== subjects[0]?.id` to the render condition.
